databases.name: PubMed
databases.query: ("Caregivers"[Mesh] OR caregiver*[tiab] OR carer*[tiab] OR "care partner*"[tiab] OR caregiving[tiab]) AND ("Large Language Models"[Mesh] OR "Generative Artificial Intelligence"[Mesh] OR chatbot*[tiab] OR "large language model*"[tiab] OR LLM[tiab] OR LLMs[tiab] OR "conversational agent*"[tiab] OR "conversational AI"[tiab] OR "conversational artificial intelligence"[tiab] OR "generative AI"[tiab] OR "generative artificial intelligence"[tiab] OR ChatGPT[tiab] OR "virtual assistant*"[tiab] OR "voice assistant*"[tiab]) AND english[la] NOT (editorial[pt] OR comment[pt] OR letter[pt] OR news[pt])

databases.name: arXiv
databases.query: (abs:caregiver OR abs:caregivers OR abs:caregiving OR abs:carer OR abs:carers OR abs:"care partner" OR abs:"care partners") AND (abs:"language model" OR abs:"language models" OR abs:LLM OR abs:LLMs OR abs:chatbot OR abs:chatbots OR abs:"conversational agent" OR abs:"conversational agents" OR abs:"conversational AI" OR abs:"generative AI" OR abs:ChatGPT OR abs:"voice assistant" OR abs:"voice assistants")
